title: Glow From Within: Essential Skincare Prep Every Bride Needs Before Her Big Day
excerpt: Flawless bridal makeup starts long before the wedding day — discover the skincare prep secrets that give every bride her most luminous, camera-ready glow.
content:
Your wedding day makeup is only as stunning as the canvas beneath it. At Velora Bella, we always remind our Fort Lauderdale brides that a truly flawless finish begins with a dedicated skincare routine — ideally started three to six months before the big day. Florida's humid climate can be both a blessing and a challenge for skin, making consistent hydration, gentle exfoliation, and sun protection absolute non-negotiables. Begin with a dermatologist-approved cleanser suited to your skin type, followed by a vitamin C serum to brighten and even your complexion. Incorporating a hyaluronic acid moisturizer and SPF 30 or higher daily will help combat the South Florida sun while keeping skin plump and supple.

In the weeks leading up to your wedding, focus on treatments that deliver deep nourishment without causing irritation. Hydrating sheet masks, gentle chemical exfoliants like lactic acid, and professional facials tailored for brides can make a transformative difference. We recommend scheduling your last professional facial no later than two weeks before the ceremony to allow your skin to fully settle. Avoid trying aggressive new treatments — this is not the time for chemical peels or laser resurfacing. Instead, prioritize consistency and calm.

On the morning of your wedding, keep your skincare routine simple and intentional. Cleanse, apply a lightweight serum, moisturize generously, and finish with a primer designed to blur pores and extend makeup wear. Our Velora Bella artists always work with your existing skincare to ensure seamless blending and a finish that photographs beautifully from ceremony to reception.

title: Beyond the Portfolio: How to Choose a Bridal Makeup Artist Who Truly Gets Your Vision
excerpt: Choosing the right bridal makeup artist is one of the most important decisions you'll make for your wedding day beauty.
content:
Selecting a bridal makeup artist is far more than scrolling through Instagram feeds and falling in love with a highlight technique. The right artist becomes your creative partner, your morning-of calm, and the professional who ensures every photograph captures the most radiant version of you. Begin by examining portfolios with intention — look for versatility across skin tones, ages, and wedding styles. A luxury artist should demonstrate mastery in both soft, ethereal bridal looks and bold, editorial aesthetics. Pay close attention to how their work holds up in natural and flash photography, since your wedding images will last a lifetime.

Once you've narrowed down your favorites, prioritize a trial appointment before committing. This session reveals everything: their communication style, product quality, sanitation practices, and ability to truly listen. Bring inspiration images but stay open to their professional guidance. Ask about the specific brands they use, their experience with your skin type, and whether they offer airbrush versus traditional application. A seasoned Fort Lauderdale bridal artist will also understand Florida's humid climate and select long-wearing formulas that won't melt during an outdoor ceremony.

Finally, trust your instincts about personality and professionalism. Your makeup artist will be in your bridal suite during one of the most emotionally charged mornings of your life. You deserve someone who radiates calm confidence, arrives prepared, and makes you feel celebrated — not rushed. Review contracts carefully, confirm travel fees, and always secure your date with a signed agreement. The perfect artist isn't just talented; they're the right fit for you.
